reference_change.summary: Normalize archive ordering, ownership, and timestamps; omit gzip header timestamps and names; document the rules and tool requirement.
reference_change.rationale: Identical built file contents can otherwise produce different archive bytes across packaging machines or times.
reference_change.limitations: GNU tar is required. File contents and permission bits are not normalized; no claim of universal cross-toolchain reproducibility is supported.
reference_change.breaking_changes: No public application interface is removed; the documented build tool requirement narrows to GNU tar.
